title: Research: selected m=73 complex stock shape A=0 under finite-stock-as-C (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Bounded follow-up to [#3113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3113) under priority revision 6, card `selected-stock-envelope`. That package already bound the finite per-level stock allowance `B_bits = 2642` and the halving guard, and left the shape constants `A`, `B`, and `rho` of

```text
sigma <= (43/26)*(1-s)*(A+B) + rho
```

unbound because the pinned complex cover note stated no `w`-shaped per-level divisor.

Under the finite-stock-as-`C` reading already named by `research/selected-coarse-depth-stock/PROOF.md`, this package proves the selected m=73 complex per-level divisor candidate is independent of atom width `w`, so

```text
log_2 C(w) <= A * w + B
```

holds with **A = 0** and **B = 2642**. Ordinary BIT retains `A ≥ 4096` via the digit tower; the complex `Sp(72,2)` cover has no such lift. Leaf reserve `rho` remains unbound. **No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918.

## Result

Package: `research/selected-stock-shape-a-zero/`.
Tip: `eb215c6418b1f60dea8f4b8fe966f39328dcbd80`.
Content tip: `9b257d8e75bf205d150b4d2a6a8280f5e1d8f76a`.
Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/selected-stock-shape-a-zero/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/selected-stock-shape-a-zero/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/selected-stock-shape-a-zero/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/selected-stock-shape-a-zero/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-stock-shape-a-zero
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_SELECTED_STOCK_SHAPE_A_ZERO A=0 B_bits=2642 rho=unbound no_digit_tower_lift no_new_kappa
PASS_SELECTED_STOCK_SHAPE_A_ZERO A=0 B_bits=2642 rho=unbound no_digit_tower_lift no_new_kappa_INDEPENDENT
PASS_SELECTED_STOCK_SHAPE_A_ZERO_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/selected-stock-shape-a-zero outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#3113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3113) for `B_bits=2642` and the explicit missing-lemma `A_B_rho_unbound`. This package answers only the A obligation; it does not recompute B or the halving guard, and it does not close `rho` or a full `sigma` envelope. Does not reopen #3411, #3392, #3386, #3374, #3349, deferred V45, or the merged readout series through #2883.

Credit Aaron Wang / #3113, Sricharan Vagvala / #2105, Adam Gall / #2084, and the retained cover notes. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
